prompt:
A sprite sheet of 12 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 4 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) simple wooden chair; 2) small round wooden table with a single candle stub (unlit); 3) bale of hay tied with twine; 4) long wooden planter box with herbs and small flowers; 5) standing wooden signboard on a post (blank board, no letters); 6) short wooden picket fence section; 7) small iron lantern standing on the ground (glass panes, unlit); 8) weathered stone grave marker; 9) small canvas tent; 10) cut log lying on its side; 11) tree stump with roots; 12) small mossy rock.
Scale: the chair is about 22 art pixels tall, the table about 26, the tent about 32 tall; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.

Exactly 12 fully separate props in a 3-COLUMN x 4-ROW grid, reading left to right, top to bottom, spacious empty transparent gutters, all silhouettes fully within canvas. Row 1: (1) simple upright wooden chair; (2) small round wooden table bearing one UNLIT candle stub; (3) bale of hay tied with twine. Row 2: (4) long wooden planter box containing herbs and small flowers; (5) blank standing wooden signboard on a post, absolutely no writing; (6) short wooden picket fence section. Row 3: (7) small iron lantern resting on its base, glass panes, UNLIT; (8) weathered stone gravemarker; (9) small canvas tent. Row 4: (10) cut log lying sideways with visible circular end; (11) tree stump with roots; (12) small mossy rock. Consistent classic three-quarter top-down RPG viewpoint with top surfaces and front faces visible, upright objects with bases downward. Chair ~22 source-art pixels tall, table ~26, tent ~32, same consistent source pixel size for every sprite, enlarged at integer scale to about 8x8 output pixels per art pixel. Premium modern hi-bit 2D HD pixel art, crisp square hard-edged hand-placed pixels, deliberate clusters of 3-10 pixels, no antialiasing, no blurred lines, no gradients, no soft brushes, no noise, no photographic texture, no checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy worn lived-in palette, 4-6 flat shades per material, hue-shifted color ramps with saturated purple/red shadows and warm yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left illumination like calm overcast evening, CLEAN BASE COLORS only. NO cast shadows, NO drop shadows, NO ground planes, NO dark nighttime lighting, NO glow, NO light sources, NO light pools, NO vignette. Entire background and spacing fully transparent alpha. No text, labels, numbers, border, other props or extra elements.
